description: Migration script for version 5.7.0 of OrangeHRM, handling database schema updates, language string cleanup, and permission insertions.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Handles database migration tasks for OrangeHRM version 5.7.0, including schema updates, language string cleanup, and permission setup.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration steps: deletes language strings, updates data groups, inserts permissions, drops old tables, and creates new error tables.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translation entries for a specific language string unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: dropOldTables
methods.description: Drops legacy tables no longer used in the new schema.

methods.name: insertI18NError
methods.description: Inserts a new internationalization error message into the database.

methods.name: deleteUnusedLangStrings
methods.description: Removes obsolete language strings from various groups.
